title: Phone polish wave 8: admin setup and content, then close-out

criteria.text: Doug: Reopen + Clear Downstream on the playoff BYE editor asks first (ConfirmDialog, closes after the action, pending state, Cancel makes no call; tests cover confirm and cancel). Its four buttons are readable in light, dark and winter (red text-destructive-text; amber/green -700; dark twins) and a tap leaves no pale fill in dark.
criteria.evidence: ByeMatchEditor.test.tsx: tap makes no call, 'Reopen and clear' calls toggle(true), the question then closes (313c094), Cancel makes no call; ConfirmDialog isPending disables both buttons (handler sets isTogglingStatus before its first await, reviewer verified). Contrast measured in the app's real CSS (scratchpad w8/bye.mjs, bg-background + muted box): light 4.95-5.83 rest / 4.50-5.11 tapped; dark 6.63-11.55 / 6.45-10.23; winter 6.29-10.95 / 6.15-9.58; tapped tint stays dark (e.g. 12,21,36) in dark and winter. No BYE match in the fake data, so not seen inside the real editor.

criteria.text: Admin setup at 320 and 390 px: Timeslots delete button visible with no sideways swipe; Timeslots date button and Participation season select full width below sm; New Division text inside its button; Team Management tabs in an even 2x2 grid; Auto Schedule switch tap areas no longer overlap; blind draw sign-ups table scrolls sideways instead of clipping. Desktop 1280 unchanged.
criteria.evidence: QA browser @894b352, admin mock, 320/390 touch + 1280: Timeslots delete btn 44x44 inside table (right 262<=270 @320), table+doc scroll 0; date btn = parent width below sm (238/308), 240 @1280; Participation select full width (288/358), 200 @1280; New Division text inside button all widths; Teams tabs grid-cols-2 even 140/175 cols, inline-flex row @1280; Auto Schedule switch 44px tap areas 56px apart, no overlap; blind draw table wrapper overflow-x auto; no console errors

criteria.text: Edit Team is a bottom sheet below 768 px (ResponsiveDialog, dismissible=false so a swipe cannot throw typed edits away); centred on desktop as before; a test covers the sheet prop.
criteria.evidence: QA browser: 320/390 Edit Team opens as vaul drawer (bottom 800, full width); after typing, Escape, tap outside and a drag-down did not close it and the typed value stayed; control drag closes the dismissible Sections drawer; Cancel closes. 1280: centred dialog 672 wide, Cancel closes. EditTeamDialog.sheet.test.tsx passes (dismissible=false)

criteria.text: Footer sits at the bottom of the screen on short pages (phone and desktop): PageTransition around the routes is a growing flex column; no page layout changes otherwise.
criteria.evidence: QA browser: footer bottom = viewport bottom (gap 0) on /no-such-page 390x1100 and 1280x800 and /admin/divisions 390x1600; /schedule 390 and 1280 footer below fold after content (doc 1546/1415), no sideways scroll

criteria.text: Message board: on a member's own post at 320 px the time drops to its own line when the names do not fit, so the username shows more than 2 letters.
criteria.evidence: QA browser member 320: own post fake_player_1a time wraps to its own line (time top 851 vs name top 829); username shows 'fake...' (46 of 97 px visible, 4 letters) - screenshot 320-mb-own.png

criteria.text: Contrast in light: SOS and win%/standings % helpers use the lowest passing shade (green-700, orange-700, hard red-600, very hard red-700; dark unchanged; sweep helpers untouched per Doug). Contact inbox Verified, Join and Score badges -700 in light; 11 px dates and Expires/Expired on contact inbox and notifications are 12 px. Tests updated to the new values.
criteria.evidence: Code: SOS easy green-700, moderate orange-700, hard red-700, very hard red-800 (red-600 measured 4.35 on /stats zebra rows by QA, so red-700 is the lowest passing shade and very hard moved one darker to stay distinct); win%/standings green-700, blue-600, orange-700, red-700; dark and sweep unchanged; tests updated values only. QA measured on real pixels: /stats green-700 4.68, orange-700 4.91, blue-600 4.96, red-700 6.08; axe color-contrast 0 on /stats and /history. Inbox Score 4.62, Join 4.86; dates and Expires 12 px.

criteria.text: Doug: the /setup-profile league-name field reads Display Name with the hint 'The name other players see. At least 3 letters or numbers.'; placeholder, toast and error messages match; blind draw First name untouched; tests and profile docs (set-up-your-profile, accounts-and-roles, glossary, verification) match.
criteria.evidence: QA browser member /setup-profile 320 and 1280 (reached via the Edit Profile link route; form shows when signed in): label 'Display Name *', placeholder 'Enter your display name', hint 'The name other players see. At least 3 letters or numbers.', no 'First Name'; toast/schema strings in diff; docs (set-up-your-profile, accounts-and-roles, glossary, verification/getting-started PROFILE-08) updated; glossary blind draw 'first name' untouched

criteria.text: Close-out: verification README suspected-bug count is recounted and correct; every still-open plan item (bags prompt, bell label, Create Bracket 320 list, mock POST gap, Doug's leave-colours decision, own-phone check) is recorded in its feature doc or fixture notes; docs/plans/PHONE-POLISH-2026-11.md is deleted and no doc links to it; no new console errors and no sideways scroll on touched routes.
criteria.evidence: QA: verification README says 113 P1 + 2 P2 suspected bugs; recount of rows = 113 P1 + 2 P2 (NAV-10, MSG-07); docs/plans/PHONE-POLISH-2026-11.md gone, no .md links to it; open items found in docs/fixtures (bell, bags prompt kept, Create Bracket 320 list, validate_division_seeds mock gap, leave-colours in power-score.md, not tried on a real phone); 0 console errors and 0 doc overflow on every touched route in QA probes

reviews.summary: Independent reviewer at 894b352: Wave 8 meets the request; BYE clear asks first and cannot double-fire; Edit Team sheet closes only from its buttons on phone, desktop unchanged; no tests weakened; recount correct; control files untouched. 4 non-blocking suggestions: closes-after-reset test and ConfirmDialog error comment added (313c094), Escape doc row fixed (75ff76e), criterion 6 shade wording explained in its evidence; Timeslots desktop Actions heading is now screen-reader only (documented in manage-timeslots.md).
